title:
Build with Google Antigravity, our new agentic development platform
            
            
            - Google Developers Blog

facts.fact: Google Antigravity was introduced as a new agentic development platform, announced in a Google Developers Blog post dated November 20, 2025.
Google Antigravity is available in public preview at no cost for individuals.
facts.quote: Google Antigravity is available today in public preview, at no cost for individuals.

facts.fact: Google Antigravity is compatible with MacOS, Windows, and Linux.
facts.quote: This cross-platform solution is compatible with MacOS, Windows, and Linux

facts.fact: Google Antigravity offers generous rate limits on Gemini 3 Pro, without stating a specific limit.
facts.quote: offering model optionality with generous rate limits on Gemini 3 Pro

facts.fact: Google Antigravity provides full support for Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 4.5 and OpenAI's GPT-OSS models.
facts.quote: full support for Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 4.5 and OpenAI's GPT-OSS.

facts.fact: Google Antigravity has two interaction views: an Editor View for hands-on AI-powered IDE work and a Manager Surface for spawning and orchestrating multiple agents asynchronously.
facts.quote: The platform introduces two distinct ways to interact with your code
